summary: Chunk 4 (ch06 units 124-164): draft is largely faithful and careful with damaged print (128, 135, 139, 152 unsplit/unclear, hedged). 3 errors, 73 minor. Errors: 'bilva (wood-apple)' is a wrong common name (Aegle marmelos = bael) in 158 (English + gloss); 'colic pain' for śūla in 126 (glossary: pain). Minor: tastes lists labelled bahuvrīhi instead of dvandva, gender on unstated nouns, Pitta/Vāta capitalisation in English, Hindi additions of 'हो', bare Sanskrit terms in Hindi (आम collides with mango in 154), pairing stated as fact in GROUPING notes, 139 English left broken off. No regrouping suggested; running sentences are 126-127, 128-129, 134-135, 136-137, 140-141, 143-144, 145-146, 154-156, 158-159, 160-161. Unresolved for the owner: 128/135 'tarapāna', 132 'rakte raktena' and pittāsra possibly = raktapitta, 134/136 list sense, 139 lava, 152 sadrusam, 163 yathāpatham, kacchurā/raktamūlin/kattṛṇa identities. Text-flag conjectures (146 kaṭu, 153 nirāmāṇām, 134/143 śakṛ, 140/145 viṣi, 150, 154 jambvāmra) are plausible and src is kept as printed.
glossary_suggestions: bilva = bael (Aegle marmelos), NOT 'wood-apple' (that is kapittha); Hindi बिल्व यानी बेल.
Lists of tastes (kaṭu-amla-lavaṇa etc.) = dvandva in gram, never bahuvrīhi; no gender when the noun (basti, pāna) is unstated.
Hindi आम (āma) collides with mango: always write 'आम यानी अपक्व पदार्थ' at first use per chunk, and 'आम्र यानी आम' for the tree.
vātena = Vāta in English; samīraṇa/anila/māruta/vāyu = 'wind'; Pitta capitalised in compounds.
pittāsra/asṛkpitta are also names of the disease raktapitta; keep 'pitta and blood' in lists of combinations and note the alternative.
Hindi pala = 'पल यानी तौल की इकाई'; no 'एक'.
samaṅgā probable Mimosa pudica (लाजवन्ती) disputed; kaṭvaṅga probable Oroxylum indicum (सोनापाठा) disputed; plakṣa probable Ficus virens (पाकड़), hedge in Hindi too.
